title: mixcore core API v0.3 (additive, demo mixer): StartDemo(requestJSON)
description: Starts the built-in demo mixer: the family's console simulator, inside the app process, on a UDP socket bound to 127.0.0.1 with a port the OS picks. It is seeded with a plausible show (named channels, faders, mutes, mute groups, DCAs) and its meters move like music. The result (demo-mixer.schema.json) tells where it listens; the app then calls Start with that family, host and port like for any console, and every message of that session carries demo: true. Nothing runs before StartDemo or after StopDemo. Only one demo mixer runs per engine: StartDemo while one runs is ERR_ALREADY_STARTED.

family.description: Which console the demo mixer is. x32: 32 inputs, 6 mute groups, 8 DCAs. xair: 16 inputs, 4 mute groups, 4 DCAs (its buses, sends and colours are seeded too, for when the model carries them).

deskChanges.description: true: every 30 s the demo moves one fader by itself, as an engineer at the desk would (origin console), so the external-change UI can be seen. false (default): nothing changes unless the user does it.
